verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a rule engine that can be built around business entities and a no-code rule editor that runs ingested transaction events to flag anomalous behavior. It also documents automated handling such as auto-clearing low-risk sanctions matches and escalating real exposure, so event-driven rules are its own capability. However, the evidence only mentions this briefly and never shows how rules map to specific automated actions (block, route, alert) or what action types are configurable. Missing for 10: documented rule-to-action configuration (available actions, triggers, conditions), detailed rule-engine docs beyond one-line mentions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
